import builtins
import io
import pathlib
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, NoReturn

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print a log line formatted as `[level] message` to standard output.

    Console output only: this function must not open, create, or write to
    any file, and must not print anything to standard error.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "hello")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] hello\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_message_with_spaces_and_symbols(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("WARN", "disk 90% full: /dev/sda1 [check]")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[WARN] disk 90% full: /dev/sda1 [check]\n"


def test_level_is_not_altered(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("debug", "x")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[debug] x\n"


def test_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] \n"


def test_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "msg")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] msg\n"


def test_one_line_per_call(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "first")
    log_line("ERROR", "second")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] first\n[ERROR] second\n"


def test_does_not_touch_file_system(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    def forbidden(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> NoReturn:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not touch the file system")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(io, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, "write_text", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, "write_bytes", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, "touch", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, "mkdir", forbidden)

    log_line("INFO", "console only")

    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
